A Welcome From Our Headteacher
“At Reigate School, we are proud to offer a supportive and ambitious environment where every student is encouraged to achieve their full potential. Our dedicated staff work tirelessly to provide a broad, balanced, and challenging curriculum that inspires curiosity and confidence. We aim to develop well-rounded young people prepared to thrive academically, socially, and personally—in an ever-changing world.While strong exam results are essential, enjoying school life and making the most of the opportunities we offer is just as crucial.”

pageCache.text:
Open Evening and School Tours
At Reigate School, we are proud of the warm, purposeful atmosphere that visitors consistently comment on. We believe the best way to understand what makes our school exceptional is to experience it in person. Throughout the year, we offer a range of opportunities for families to learn more about our community and see our children’s learning in action.
Open Evening
Our annual Open Evening takes place each October and is one of the largest events in our calendar. It offers families the chance to explore our departments, meet our dedicated staff, and speak with children about their learning. The next Open Evening will be held on Thursday 1st October 2026.
Visitors will have the opportunity to hear from our Headteacher and discover more about the ambition, culture and values that underpin everything we do at Reigate School. Our commitment to helping children achieve their academic, social, and personal potential sits at the heart of our ethos and guides our daily practice. We warmly encourage families considering Reigate School as their choice of secondary education to attend this event and see the energy and excellence that characterise our day to day school life.
School Tours (During the School Day)
Once a term, we run our popular open door school tours, where parents and carers can visit the school during a normal working day. These tours provide a unique window into our classrooms, allowing you to see our academic culture in action, observe high‑quality teaching and experience the calm, focused environment that supports our children’s success.
Tours are led by a member of our Senior Leadership Team.
Sessions begin at 9:10am and 10:10am.
Tours are ideal for families moving into the area or exploring school choices for the future.
Places are limited and must be booked in advance by contacting the school office on 01737 243166.
The next tours will take place in September/October 2026 from Monday 28th September to Wednesday 30th September 2026 and Monday 5th October to Friday 9th October 2026.
